text: The findings of the entire study sample did not differ from a subsample restricted to the US alone.

With the government‐mandated stay‐at‐home orders, individuals with obesity had the largest increase to healthy eating behaviors (1.13 [0.08] compared with 0.67 [0.08] and 0.83 [0.08] for normal weight and overweight, respectively, P < 0.001).
